60/S0.subgoal: Explain the overall goal of the lecture: linking theory to practical system implementation.

60/S1.subgoal: Describe the stages of the interactive system development lifecycle (ISDLC).

60/S2.subgoal: Identify the Unity platform as the primary tool for implementing XR concepts.

60/S3.subgoal: Explain why a support environment like Unity is essential for efficient implementation.

60/S4.subgoal: Describe the core features and technical overview of the Unity platform.

60/S5.subgoal: Explain how the Unity interface supports different types of XR systems (VR, AR, MR).

60/S6.subgoal: Identify and describe the major components of the Unity developer interface.

60/S7.subgoal: Distinguish between the Scene View (developer's view) and the Game View (final view).

60/S8.subgoal: Explain the fundamental concept of Unity assets and their origins.

60/S9.subgoal: Define a scene as a specific type of asset within a Unity project.

60/S10.subgoal: Explain the function of GameObjects and how components provide functionality to them.

60/S11.subgoal: Define prefabs and explain their use as reusable templates in Unity.

60/S12.subgoal: Summarize the core concepts covered in the lecture regarding Unity and XR implementation.
